The current low-level goals (LLGs) are complete and correctly realize the parent high-level goal (HLG). Both LLGs document functional interactions that support the administrator's role in managing facility data. The first LLG, 'Submit facility data for review by administrator' (llg_001), aligns with the HLG's requirement for administrators to oversee and verify submitted facility information. The second LLG, 'Update facility operational status or contact details' (llg_002), corresponds to the need for administrators to maintain accurate and up-to-date operational data. There are no unsupported or misleading LLGs, nor any missing essential capabilities in this decomposition.

The documentation of automatic effects, such as system notifications upon data submission or updates, does not require a manual trigger by the administrator actor, adhering to the specified criteria for LLG evaluation.

There is no need for regeneration, as all documented parent capabilities are present, supported, and distinct. The scope of each LLG is appropriate, focusing on specific administrative tasks without redundancy or overlap.
